~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Step 5: Creating resistance surface
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

```{r}
m0_dry <- here("outputs", "m0_dry.rds")
m0_wet <- here("outputs", "m0_wet.rds")

# load raster stack here

coefs_dry <- coef(m0_dry)
coefs_wet <- coef(m0_wet)

landscape_coefs_dry <- coefs_dry[c("built_2020", "cropland_2020", "grassland_2020", "shrub_2020", 
                                   "tree_2020", "water_2020", "core_dist_rast", 
                                   "rivers_dist_rast", "roads_distance_rast", "fences_dist_rast", 
                                   "pop_density_2020", "dry_szn_evi_2020", 
                                   "dry_spei3_fill_na_neg2_2020", "elevation", "slope", "aspect")]

landscape_coefs_wet <- coefs_wet[c("built_2020", "cropland_2020", "grassland_2020", "shrub_2020", 
                                   "tree_2020", "water_2020", "core_dist_rast", 
                                   "rivers_dist_rast", "roads_distance_rast", "fences_dist_rast", 
                                   "pop_density_2020", "wet_szn_evi_2020", "wet_spei3_grid_2020", 
                                   "elevation", "slope", "aspect")]
```
